steps.content: Outside the car window, huge clusters of rusty substances are floating in the air and constantly growing, looking like foreign subjects intruding from another space. The noise of metal twisting is echoing, sounding like someone's shouts and wails.
The purple light in the sky looks like Zoya's ever-crumbling spiritual world, yet the dwindling Statue of Keylan in the rear-view mirror reminds you this is the reality.

The top of the statue is shrouded by the purple light, electric arcs flashing around it occasionally. That's the last place Zoya went. Higher up, at the apex of the sky, an enormous and luminous red ring cloaks everything below.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: That's the Black Ring. Stop staring at it like that, or your consciousness will be dragged away again.
He grips the steering wheel. It looks like he's stolen one of the FAC's armored vehicles this time.
Stolen may not be the right word though... After all, there's probably no one else left alive around here.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: The two girls are at the back. Their minds were linked to you through the shackles, and they were affected by the Black Ring because you were linked to Zoya. They've suffered a lot.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: Good thing you woke up in time. If the two of them break down together too, I'm afraid I'll have to cancel the job and bounce.
You look toward the back seat. The two Sinners are leaning against each other and dozing. Even the slightest shake of the car makes them frown, as if they're having some kind of nightmare.
The FAC soldier who was with us... What happened to him?

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: ...The contamination was too serious. I couldn't bring his body with us. I covered his body the best I could and left him there.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: If he had died outside the Black Ring, the FAC's cleanup unit could have retrieved his body and given him a proper burial. But he died in the Ring. Now they can only carve his name on the cenotaph.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: I only found this, he seemed to treasure it a lot. Take it, and when you're out, see if you can find his family or friends and hand it to them.
You take the photo from him. It's still wet with fresh bloodstains. You remember you've glimpsed a corner of this photo from the hole in his pierced armor.

In the photo, 036 is standing with many other FAC soldiers. Several heads are obviously cropped from other pictures and glued on. A list of names without faces is written on the back, completing this bizarre group photo.
Except for himself, a name and a date are noted for each person. The dates are all not far from now, and the names are all in full instead of just a number like 036.
You realize this is a group photo of the deceased. He'd always kept it in his left breastplate, closest to his heart.
Deaths are part of the game. If you can't accept this, you don't deserve to fight for the FAC.
Yes. I'm a member of an FAC combat unit. To fight Black Rings, I can discard all emotions.
You lower your head. Your hand grips the photo tightly unconsciously.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: The space within the Ring is distorted, so it'll take some time to find the way out. But I'll be sure to escort you out while someone is still able to hold Zoya back.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: You've done your best. Leave the rest to us.
You're done collecting yourself and have made the decision.

options: You seem unaffected by the Black Ring

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: You can say that. We have some special protective measures. That's our trade secret, I can't reveal it to you.

options: Good. Turn back and take me back, please

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: You gotta be kidding me.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: ...Cut it out. Given your current state, I'll be sending you there to die if I drive you back.
Before he finishes, you reach out to grab his ear.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: ...Is this workplace harassment? I'll sue you.
In fact, your first reaction was to grab his neck, but his scarf was in the way, so you lifted your hand a little higher. But anyway, you're in contact with him.

options: Please do me a favor, Sinner. Or else...

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: How did you know...? Anyway, is this how you're gonna repay me for my kindness?
Take this as a new job. Please drive me to the statue, you can bill all the extra charges to the MBCC.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: So—rry, but I don't take suicide requests, no matter how much you're offering.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: This is the Ring born from Zoya. Every rule here, including the laws of physics and spacetime, is governed by her will. This is her realm, and she is no longer the Zoya you know.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: A Sinner's power comes entirely from their own manic spirit, and the power is bound to be no match for the black hole within themselves. Now that the Ring already has a grip on her darkness, everything is over.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: Because of the shackles, you're now the person closest to the contamination, followed by your Sinners. What are you trying to do by going back, besides getting both yourself and them killed?

options: To do something only I can do

steps.content: Only she can destroy the Ring born from her. I'm going to wake Zoya. The shackles are still connected to her, only I can do this.
After taking me there, you'll get out of this place with them.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: Like playing the hero, don't you?

options: I don't have any other way out, anyway. I can't run away from this

steps.content: The shackles are linked to Zoya. If I don't deal with her, I'll be swallowed too, sooner or later. That's why I must stay and fight.
If I die here, at least they can be free.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: ...Give me a break. That's really cringy.
You don't have time to waste either. The person holding Zoya back is your friend, right? Do you really think your friend can win on his own?
If someone can hold Zoya back, then our last hope should be to make it there in time and join forces with them.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: Don't be a fool. She's not like you. She'll run if she finds herself losing!

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: Tsk! You better be useful if you're going.
He swings the steering wheel and the car does a 180. He slams his foot down on the gas pedal and shoots toward the statue.

Strangely enough, while it took you a long time to drive all the way here during your escape, it takes way shorter to drive back to the statue. As you push open the car door, you find the air filled with the smell of smoke and rust.

The statue is already covered in layers of the clustered substance that's leaking out, looking like an enormous tower of rust. The creaking noise it makes is mixed with the hisses and growls of monsters.

One after another, monsters are being formed in the contamination jungle like evil fruits growing on the huge tower. Although they don't seem aggressive toward you, they're blocking the statue's entrance thoroughly.

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: We're here. What are you gonna do next? Are you sure you can go up on your own? How are you gonna fight these monsters?

steps.speaker: Blond Driver
steps.content: You're not thinking of kidnapping me as your Sinner, are you?
You steady your emotions, clear your mind, and reach out your hand to use your power.
As if sensing your power, a monster suddenly turns back and charges at you.
No!

steps.speaker: Attacking Monster
steps.content: Guahhh!!
A furious Nightmare jumps out behind you, howling and ripping the monsters into pieces.
Behind you, Hecate struggles to peek out while clutching onto the car door. Hella emerges as well, holding up her pipe and looking at you with an undecipherable look in her eyes.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: ...Don't use it, the power's burden is too heavy on you. You don't need to fight like that. That's... my job.

steps.speaker: Hecate
steps.content: Chief, use me to fight. I can still fight for you.
She's still very weak, yet her eyes have never been more determined, mixed with a hint of anxiety.
